title: Urology and Continence Supply Program delivery cushion for heavy straight-tip catheter use on Original Medicare notices
content:
A liability notice for straight-tip intermittent catheters (A4351) on the Continence Original Medicare Program of the Urology and Continence Supply Program carries a delivery cushion for heavy use. The cushion is set by how heavily the customer's newest straight-tip order uses catheters.

## Cushion schedule

| Newest straight-tip written order, units per 30 days | Added to the notice units |
|---|---|
| 240 or more | the expected-denial quantity per 30 days times 5 days divided by 30, rounded down |
| at least 180 but fewer than 240 | the expected-denial quantity per 30 days times 3 days divided by 30, rounded down |
| fewer than 180 | nothing |

The newest written order is the straight-tip order with the latest order date.

## Boundaries and arithmetic (hypothetical)

- An order of 250 per 30 days takes the 5-day row, and an order of 239 takes the 3-day row.
- An order of 180 per 30 days takes the 3-day row, and an order of 179 adds nothing.
- With an expected-denial quantity of 50 per 30 days on the 5-day row, the addition is 50 times 5 divided by 30, which is 8.33, rounded down to 8 units.
